caption_L1: This is a line plot named U.S. production of tomatoes for processing from 2000 to 2018 (in tons). The x-axis measures Year. A linear scale from 0 to 15,000,000 can be seen on the y-axis, labeled Production in tons.
caption_L2L3: The production of tomatoes in the US fluctuates year on year but overall there has been a slight increase over the period 2000 to 2018. 2015 saw the most tomatoes produced with almost 15 million tonnes ready for processing.
